The organ features a massive wooden case with intricate baroque-style carvings and gilding. Multiple tiers of vertical silver/metallic pipes of varying heights are visible, arranged symmetrically behind the wooden framework. The perspective looks up towards the ceiling, emphasizing the height of the instrument.
